parsed.name: XCalibur 分配阀注射泵
parsed.name_en: XCalibur Syringe Pump with Distribution Valve
parsed.description: 用于实验室液路切换与精密吸液/分液的 XCalibur 注射泵。该设备可控制柱塞绝对/相对位置、阀口切换、运行速度、微步模式和命令序列，并支持向废液口排放、管路预充和初始化，适合自动化样品转移、灌注和流体处理。
parsed.description_en: An XCalibur syringe pump for laboratory fluid routing and precise aspiration/dispensing. It controls absolute/relative plunger motion, valve port switching, motion speeds, microstepping, and command sequences, and supports waste dispensing, line priming, and initialization for automated sample transfer, priming, and fluid handling.
